members.label: Formanta
members.differences: The original, Formanta's 1982 Soviet synth, designed by Vladimir Kuzmin and sold only in the USSR: two generators with five waveforms and five ranges, Generator II able to frequency-modulate Generator I, noise, a low-pass or band-pass filter known for its harsh resonance, two envelopes that can repeat, and a 49-note keyboard that plays two notes at once.

members.label: Behringer (announced)
members.differences: Announced, not yet on sale. Behringer's copy, made with Vladimir Kuzmin, who designed the original and died in 2026. The finished unit shown at Music China in October 2026 is a slanted Eurorack case with two oscillators with detune and pulse-width modulation, a low-pass and band-pass filter, a switch between monophonic and duophonic play, MIDI In, and CV and gate. No price or date has been given.
